00670|     def is_proprietary(self, package_info: Dict[str, any]) -> bool:
00671|         """

00676|

00679|         """

00686|

00688|             if license_summary["is_proprietary"]:

00690|             
00691|             # If all licenses are FOSS, mark as FOSS
00692|             if license_summary["is_foss"]:

00711|                 prop_pkg_lower.startswith(package_lower + '-') or

00751|     def scan_manager(self, manager: PackageManager) -> List[Dict[str, any]]:
00752|         """Scan a specific package manager for proprietary software."""
00753|         packages = manager.get_installed_packages()
00754|         proprietary = []
00755|         
00756|         # Process packages concurrently for proprietary detection
00757|         max_workers = min(32, len(packages)) if packages else 1
00758|         
00759|         with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
00760|             # Submit all detection tasks
00761|             future_to_package = {

00763|                 for package in packages
00764|             }
00765|             
00766|             # Collect results as they complete
00767|             for future in as_completed(future_to_package):
00768|                 package = future_to_package[future]
00769|                 try:
00770|                     is_proprietary, detection_reason = future.result()
00771|                     if is_proprietary:
